tasks.title: Setup Raspberry Pi Development Environment
tasks.description: Configure the Raspberry Pi with required OS, dependencies, and development tools for the Gwent Companion system.
tasks.details: Install Raspberry Pi OS, configure Python environment, set up version control, install necessary libraries for RFID communication, audio output, and REST API development. Configure development tools and testing frameworks. Set up SQLite database.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify OS installation, confirm all dependencies are installed correctly, test database connection, and validate development environment with a simple hello-world application.

tasks.title: Implement RFID Card Detection System
tasks.description: Develop the core RFID reading system that can detect and identify Gwent cards placed on the game mat.
tasks.details: Integrate RFID reader hardware with Raspberry Pi, write Python modules for card detection and identification, implement multiple card detection capability, optimize for < 100ms response time, add error handling for misreads, and create a card identification database.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with sample RFID-enabled cards, measure detection speed, verify multiple card detection capabilities, and validate error handling under various conditions including interference.

tasks.title: Develop Game State Management System
tasks.description: Create the core game logic that tracks and manages the Gwent game state based on card placements and player actions.
tasks.details: Implement Gwent game rules in Python, develop card placement tracking, create point calculation system, build round management logic, implement turn tracking, and add victory condition monitoring. Design system to handle state updates in < 50ms.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for game rules, develop integration tests for complete game flows, test edge cases in game state transitions, and validate performance metrics for state updates.

tasks.title: Build REST API and WebSocket Server
tasks.description: Develop the server-side API that enables communication between the Raspberry Pi game server and the web interface.
tasks.details: Create REST API endpoints for game state access, implement WebSocket server for real-time updates, develop authentication system, implement error handling and security measures, and ensure API response times meet performance requirements.
tasks.testStrategy: Test API endpoints with automated tools, verify WebSocket communication with test clients, benchmark response times, and conduct security testing including authentication validation.

tasks.title: Create Physical Interface Controls
tasks.description: Implement the hardware interface including display, buttons, and rotary encoder for direct interaction with the companion device.
tasks.details: Connect display to Raspberry Pi, implement display interface code, integrate rotary encoder and buttons, develop menu navigation system, create score visualization screens, and implement player prompts and error messages.
tasks.testStrategy: Test physical controls for durability and responsiveness, validate display readability, verify menu navigation flows, and conduct usability testing with sample users.

tasks.title: Implement Audio System
tasks.description: Develop the stereo speaker output system for playing sound effects and background music asynchronously during gameplay.
tasks.details: Connect stereo speakers to Raspberry Pi, implement multi-channel audio playback system in Python, create sound effect library, develop background music management, implement game event to audio mapping, and ensure asynchronous playback doesn't affect game performance.
tasks.testStrategy: Test audio quality and timing, verify multiple sound effects can play simultaneously, validate background music transitions, and measure performance impact during gameplay.

tasks.title: Develop React Web Interface (SPA)
tasks.description: Create the Glory Gate web interface for real-time game visualization, deck management, and player interaction.
tasks.details: Set up React development environment, implement responsive design with accessibility support, create real-time game state visualization components, develop deck management interface, implement game history tracking, and add statistics and analytics features.
tasks.testStrategy: Conduct component testing, verify responsive design across devices, test WebSocket integration for real-time updates, validate accessibility compliance, and perform usability testing.

tasks.title: Implement Player Guidance System
tasks.description: Create the system that provides turn prompts, legal move validation, rule clarifications, and strategy suggestions to players.
tasks.details: Develop logic for identifying legal moves, create turn prompt system, implement rule clarification database, develop strategy suggestion algorithm based on game state, and integrate with both physical and web interfaces.
tasks.testStrategy: Test accuracy of legal move validation, verify helpfulness of rule clarifications, validate strategy suggestions against expert play, and conduct user testing to assess guidance effectiveness.

tasks.title: Develop Deck Management System
tasks.description: Build the deck building, collection tracking, and deck statistics features for the web interface.
tasks.details: Create SQLite database schema for card collections and decks, implement deck building interface in React, develop deck validation logic, add deck statistics calculation, and create import/export functionality for sharing decks.
tasks.testStrategy: Test deck building with various card combinations, verify deck validation correctly identifies legal decks, validate statistics calculations, and test import/export functionality with different deck formats.

tasks.title: Implement System Integration and Deployment
tasks.description: Integrate all components, create installation process, and develop maintenance tools for the complete Gwent Companion system.
tasks.details: Integrate all hardware and software components, create automated setup scripts, implement configuration management system, develop update mechanism, add monitoring tools, implement backup system, create error reporting pipeline, and develop comprehensive documentation.
tasks.testStrategy: Conduct end-to-end testing of complete system, verify installation process on fresh hardware, test recovery from simulated failures, validate update mechanism, and perform final performance and reliability testing.

tasks.title: Hardware Component Specification
tasks.description: Document detailed specifications for all hardware components including communication protocols, GPIO pins, I2C addresses, and required Python libraries.
tasks.details: Created comprehensive hardware specifications including: RFID-RC522 reader with GPIO pin assignments, rotary encoder and push button input systems with pin mappings, I2C multiplexer (TCA9548A) configuration at address 0x70, LED matrix displays (IS31FL3731) at address 0x74 for score displays, SSD1306 OLED display with SPI configuration, power requirements, and a complete GPIO pin assignment table. Documented all required Python libraries including mfrc522-python, gaugette, qwiic_tca9548a, adafruit-circuitpython-is31fl3731, and luma.oled.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify hardware specifications against physical component datasheets, confirm GPIO pin assignments for non-conflicting usage, test I2C address configurations with i2cdetect utility, validate SPI device configurations, and test each component with their specified Python libraries to ensure compatibility and functionality.
